objective: Port dav1d to C89 — implement all remaining components until the internal AV1 decoder works correctly.

history.outcome: Proper dequant tables from dav1d integrated.

actions: Fixed MSAC decode_symbol val=-1 loop and penalty
ROOT CAUSE: frame header read through MSAC instead of raw bits
Fixed superblock size to use sh.sb128
Fixed reconstruct_block to use static buffer
Added av1C save/restore around seq header OBU parse
Added dav1d-compatible intra transform type decoding from txtp_intra1/txtp_intra2 CDFs (was hardcoded via stb_av1_txtp_from_uvmode)
Fixed corrupted txtp_intra2 CDF data in 2258-entry flat array — added stb_av1_correct_txtp_intra2 override table
Added av1C save/restore for color_range and matrix_coefficients
ROOT CAUSE IDENTIFIED: coefficient CDFs use qcat=0 but fox needs qcat=2 (qidx=72 => qcat = (72>20)+(72>60)+(72>120) = 2)
Extracted qcat=2 ICDF values from dav1d_ref/cdf.c (2133 values across 13 coefficient CDF tables)
history.outcome: PSNR 11.50 -> 11.44 dB. The qcat CDF mismatch is the single dominant remaining error. qcat=0 CDFs at qcat=2 quantization cause the MSAC to decode wrong symbols, corrupting every block.

blockers: qcat CDF mismatch: need to restructure coefficient CDF tables to support 4 qcats (0-3) and select at init via qcat = (qidx>20)+(qidx>60)+(qidx>120). ~22KB of new table data needed, extracted from dav1d and ready to add.
UV plane reconstruction wrong — secondary, may be fixed by qcat correction
Angle delta decoding not implemented for directional intra modes
TX size decoding not implemented when txfm_mode=SWITCHABLE
Skip context computation doesn't match dav1d's get_skip_ctx

Coefficient CDFs use qcat=0 but fox needs qcat=2. Need to extract qcat=1 and qcat=2 data from dav1d's cdf.c and add qcat-dependent selection (~11000 ushorts of data needed). This is the dominant remaining error.
UV plane reconstruction still wrong — may be related to qcat issue or separate UV CDF problem
Angle delta decoding not implemented for directional intra modes
TX size decoding not implemented when txfm_mode=SWITCHABLE
Skip context computation doesn't match dav1d's get_skip_ctx
